# Max Timepieces

> Max Timepieces is a private luxury horology service specializing in 1:1 Super Clone Swiss timepieces manufactured with solid 904L Oystersteel, Dandong cloned calibers, genuine sapphire crystals, and ceramic bezels. Direct private client support is managed via WhatsApp (+1 571 661-4938) and Instagram (@max_timepieces).

## Core Collections
- [Rolex Super Clones](https://maxtimepieces.com/collections/rolex/): Submariner, Daytona, GMT-Master II, Datejust, Day-Date, and Oyster Perpetual powered by Clean and VS Factory Dandong 3235, 4130, 4131, and 3285 movements.
- [Audemars Piguet Super Clones](https://maxtimepieces.com/collections/audemars-piguet/): Royal Oak 15500, 15400, and 16202 Jumbo Extra-Thin powered by cloned 4302 and 3120 calibers.
- [Patek Philippe Super Clones](https://maxtimepieces.com/collections/patek-philippe/): Nautilus 5711, 5712, and Aquanaut 5167 powered by 3K Factory 324 SC and 26-330 calibers.
- [Richard Mille Super Clones](https://maxtimepieces.com/collections/richard-mille/): RM 011, RM 035, and RM 055 forged carbon and titanium skeletonized timepieces.
- [Cartier Super Clones](https://maxtimepieces.com/collections/cartier/): Santos de Cartier, Tank Must, and Ballon Bleu with heat-blued steel hands and high-precision Swiss-quartz/automatic calibers.
- [Omega Super Clones](https://maxtimepieces.com/collections/omega/): Seamaster Diver 300M and Speedmaster Moonwatch with ceramic dials and Co-Axial cloned movements.
- [All Collections](https://maxtimepieces.com/collections/): Complete index of all 19 curated Swiss luxury collections.

## Horological Engineering & Factory Specifications
- [Clean Factory vs VS Factory Comparison](https://maxtimepieces.com/compare/clean-factory-vs-vs-factory/): Technical side-by-side analysis of case tolerances, movement reliability, and crystal clarity.
- [Dandong Clone Movements Guide](https://maxtimepieces.com/calibers/rolex-clone-movements-guide/): Complete breakdown of Dandong 3235, 4130, 4131, and 3285 cloned mechanical movements.
- [Super Clone vs Genuine Rolex Submariner](https://maxtimepieces.com/compare/super-clone-vs-genuine-rolex-submariner/): Millimeter-by-millimeter comparison covering 904L steel graining, Cerachrom bezel sintering, and timegrapher performance.
- [Interactive Caliber Grader & Factory Tool](https://maxtimepieces.com/tools/caliber-guide/): Real-time interactive caliber selector and specification analyzer.

## Service & Guarantees
- [Quality Control Protocol](https://maxtimepieces.com/about/): High-resolution 4K macro photos and timegrapher testing video provided for every order before shipment.
- [Shipping & Customs Policy](https://maxtimepieces.com/faq/): Discreet international triangular delivery (7–14 business days). 100% free replacement guarantee in the event of customs seizure.
- [1-Year Movement Warranty](https://maxtimepieces.com/faq/): Comprehensive repair or movement replacement coverage on all automatic calibers.
